name: Tatoeba Persian detailed sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR, author attribution)
approx_size: 695,149 bytes observed for primary file on 2026-10-31; weekly mutable
availability: public weekly export; Persian-only per_language/pes preferred; mutable snapshot
license_compilation: CC BY 2.0 FR weekly sentence export
license_content: CC BY 2.0 FR by default; some CC0; attribution retained for every row
commercial_use: yes with author attribution and licence conditions
privacy_risk: low (public contributor pseudonyms in provenance metadata only)
rights_verification: official Tatoeba downloads/terms, per_language/pes index and detailed-field documentation
notes: Official per_language/pes index lists pes_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2, 695,149 bytes, dated 2026-10-31. The detailed fields are id, lang, text, username, date_added, date_last_modified (tab-separated MySQL OUTFILE). Language code is ISO 639-3 `pes`, NOT `fas`. Usernames, sentence IDs, dates, source filename and Tatoeba CC BY 2.0 FR attribution stay in metadata; training text is only the Persian sentence. The export is mutable weekly: download_manifest.json records the observed snapshot date, actual SHA-256 and size; ordinary resume does not refresh a verified snapshot and --force is the explicit refresh. A real all-language fallback parses sentences_detailed.csv inside sentences_detailed.tar.bz2; it does NOT search for imaginary per-language TSV members. Some sentences may be CC0, but the detailed export does not mark them, so attribution is conservatively retained for every row.
